description: CLEAN normalization of 413 records (384 eligible, 29 excluded A1/A2) with slash-splitting and token-ledger verification.

invariant_checks.details: All non-whitespace token ledgers verified (0 lost or mutated tokens).
invariant_checks.name: non_whitespace_token_ledger_equality

invariant_checks.details: 29 elementary A1/A2 entries reliably identified and marked as excluded.
invariant_checks.name: elementary_a1_a2_exclusion_gate

invariant_checks.details: All cleaned records embed an immutable raw_record snapshot and RFC 6901 pointer.
invariant_checks.name: raw_snapshot_and_json_pointer_lock

invariant_checks.details: Reserved field 'difficulty' is strictly null across all records.
invariant_checks.name: difficulty_field_unset_guard

issues.corrective_action: Preserve exact word in 'word', separate base lemma and particle non-destructively.
issues.expected_output: lemma='account', modifier=(for)
issues.message: Preserved original word 'account (for)' while separating base lemma 'account' and particle (for).
issues.root_cause: Source specifies required phrasal preposition in parentheses.

issues.root_cause: Source list contains authentic mixed British (-ise/-our) and American (-ize) orthography.
